Body.Content:
The new Azure mobile app preview helps you stay connected to your Azure resources—anytime, anywhere. You can:

  • Check status and critical metrics of your Azure resources.
  • Get notifications and alerts about important health issues.
  • Perform simple operations to resolve common issues.

 

 

To learn more about the Azure app, read the blog post.
